entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Patna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The petitioner seeks bail in connection with Sakara P.S. Case No. 495 of 2019 dated 23.10.2019 instituted for the offences under Sections 323, 354, 376/511 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 12/13 of the POCSO Act, 2012.
2. Earlier his prayer for anticipatory bail was rejected by this Court.
3. The petitioner is alleged to have violated the privacy and person of the daughter of the informant.
4. It is the contention of the petitioner that the informant is none-else but the wife of his own cousin with whom he is contesting a Title Suit.
The houses of Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.13859 of 2024(6) dt.12-07-2024 the petitioner and the husband of the informant are situated on the same parcel of land which is under dispute.

5. It also appears from the pleadings of the petitioner that his wife has also filed a case against the husband of the informant under Section 376-D of the IPC.
6.
It appears that the two brothers, viz., the petitioner and the husband of the informant are fighting a civil case and are falsely implicating each other.

8. Re-notify on 19.07.2024.
